name: Graven Images
overview: Scripture clearly teaches that God created man in His own image, establishing a unique relationship between Creator and creation (Genesis 1:26). In response to this truth, God commands His people not to make or worship any graven images or idols, emphasizing exclusive devotion to Him alone (Exodus 20:3-5; Leviticus 26:1). These commands highlight God's jealousy for His people and warn against idolatry as a serious offense that brings consequences across generations.
